images.title: One age, three units
images.purpose: Shows Roxie's age of 4840 days becoming 116160 hours and 6969600 minutes.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three cards in a row joined by two arrows, each card larger than the last.
images.exact_structure: Three white cards in a row, left to right, each a little larger than the one before: a teal (#0072B2) outlined card reading 4840 days, an amber (#E69F00) outlined card reading 116160 hours, a reddish purple (#CC79A7) outlined card reading 6969600 minutes. Between the first and second, a dark arrow labelled × 24; between the second and third, a dark arrow labelled × 60. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The same age gives a much bigger number in a smaller unit.
